`code` gains `x-telo-caught-member: code`.
A catch list's context says which of its members carry the caught failure's code and data with `x-telo-caught-member: code | data`, so a `when:` comparing any marked chain proves coverage and every data-marked member is typed from the codes an entry matches; the analyzer no longer reads a binding named `error`.
